example.en: Industrial cooling fans must be serviced periodically to maintain optimal warehouse airflow.

words.mnemonic: 廠區排熱設備：cooling fan (冷卻散熱風扇)、exhaust fan (抽風機)。

example.en: Corporate executive suites include a fully equipped kitchen with modern appliances.

words.mnemonic: 商務套房設施：fully equipped kitchen (設備齊全的廚房)、kitchen appliances。

example.en: Facilities maintenance inspections are conducted twice a year to ensure safety compliance.

example.en: Bringing in an external consultant provides a fresh perspective on corporate restructuring.

words.mnemonic: 多益雙考點：fresh perspective (嶄新視角) 或 fresh food (生鮮食物)。

example.en: We sincerely apologize for the unexpected shipping delay caused by harsh winter blizzards.

example.en: All factory production employees must attend the mandatory annual workplace safety seminar.

words.mnemonic: 工安規定必備：safety regulations (安全法規)、safety equipment (防護安全裝備)。

example.en: The chief systems engineer presented innovative architectural plans for the data center.
example.zh: 首席系統工程師提出了針對雲端數據中心的創新架構規劃設計圖。

words.mnemonic: engine (引擎、機器) + -eer (從業專業人士) ＝ 工程師 (software engineer)。

example.en: The hotel concierge provided rooms situated along a quiet corridor overlooking the courtyard.

words.mnemonic: 住宿與辦公環境需求：quiet room (安靜客房)、quiet area (靜音區)。

example.en: Freight shipping costs include comprehensive maritime cargo loss and damage insurance.

words.mnemonic: in- (進入) + sure (確定、安全) + -ance ＝ 確保萬全的保障機制 ＝ 保險。

example.en: The training seminar facilitator will divide attendees into small collaborative workshop groups.

example.en: Safety regulators launched an investigation into the electrical equipment factory failure.

example.en: The logistics carrier sent a tracking notification when the package left the warehouse.

example.en: Total expenditures for the branch office renovation are estimated somewhere around eighty thousand dollars.

words.mnemonic: com- (共同) + mit (送出、託付) ＝ 全力託付承諾 ＝ commit to (致力於)。

example.en: It is obvious that investing in employee training yields superior long-term productivity.

words.mnemonic: ob- (在前方) + vi (道路) + -ous ＝ 擺在路正前方的 ＝ 顯而易見的。

example.en: Advanced data analytics is our firm's most potent competitive weapon in digital marketing.

example.en: Our new cloud-based software subscription remains relatively inexpensive compared to rivals.

example.en: Our downtown corporate convention hotel will host the upcoming international trade summit.

words.mnemonic: 排程與季報考點：winter recess (寒假休假)、winter season (冬季旅遊季)。

example.en: Our international consulting headquarters is strategically situated in the central financial district.

example.en: Our fashion retail brand will unveil its new spring clothing collection at next week's expo.

example.en: Actual project production expenditures closely matched our initial preliminary quarterly budget.

example.en: Streaming platforms are engaged in a fierce market battle for exclusive digital sports rights.

example.en: The corporate retreat offered valuable lessons in crisis mitigation and effective team communication.
example.zh: 這場企業共識營為危機化解與高效團隊溝通提供了寶貴的經驗教訓。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益培訓與檢討：lessons learned (學習到的經驗教訓)。

example.en: The creative advertising department will brainstorm marketing strategies for the holiday campaign.
example.zh: 創意廣告部門將齊聚一堂進行腦力激盪，為假期促銷活動集思廣益。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務會議必考複合動詞：brainstorm (腦力激盪、集思廣益)。

meaning: 大眾的/大規模的(形容詞)

example.en: Mass transit subway links allow conference delegates to commute effortlessly across the city.
example.zh: 大眾捷運運輸路網讓與會代表得以毫不費力地在全城各處穿梭通勤。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 大眾普及核心詞：mass transit (大眾運輸)、mass production (大規模量產)。

example.en: The television commercial used a funny, relatable storyline to promote the new snack brand.
example.zh: 該電視廣告運用了幽默有趣且引發共鳴的故事情節來宣傳新款零食品牌。

reviewWords.mnemonic: fun (樂趣) + -y (形容詞尾) ＝ 幽默風趣的、吸睛的。

example.en: Every team member is strongly encouraged to contribute innovative ideas during the seminar.
example.zh: 大會非常鼓勵每一位團隊成員在研討會期間積極貢獻創新構想。

reviewWords.mnemonic: con- (共同) + tribute (給予、敬獻) ＝ 共同給予 ＝ 貢獻 (contribute to)。

example.en: Our new marketing strategy generated high customer engagement across digital platforms.
example.zh: 我們的新行銷策略在各數位平台上帶來了高度的客戶參與。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 評價指標必備詞：high quality (高品質)、high priority (高優先級)。

example.en: The sales team explored three different distribution channels to reach younger demographics.
example.zh: 銷售團隊探索了三種不同的經銷管道以觸及年輕消費族群。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 方案比較常用詞：different from (與...不同)。

example.en: All clearance items in the retail store are currently marked fifty percent off.
example.zh: 零售店內的所有清倉商品目前皆標示為半價優惠。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 促銷打折最核心用語：20% off (打八折)；take a day off (請假一天)。

example.en: The next executive board meeting will be convened on the second Tuesday of November.
example.zh: 下一次執行董事會會議將於十一月的第二個星期二召開。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 物流與時程關鍵詞：next day delivery (隔日配送)、next week (下週)。

example.en: All departments must submit their annual expenditure reports before the end of December.
example.zh: 所有部門必須在十二月底前提交年度支出報告。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 截止時間常考片語：by the end of the month (月底前)。

example.en: Many employees choose to live near the subway station to reduce their daily commute time.
example.zh: 許多員工選擇住在捷運站附近以縮短每日通勤時間。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 員工通勤生活描寫動詞；亦可作形容詞 /laɪv/ live broadcast (現場直播)。

example.en: Please keep your mobile phones on silent while the training seminar is in progress.
example.zh: 培訓研討會進行期間，請將手機保持靜音狀態。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益聽力會場公告高頻連接詞：while + 進行中事件。

example.en: Our international freight service transports electronic parts to destinations around the world.
example.zh: 我們的國際貨運服務將電子零組件運往世界各地的目的地。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 跨國企業文宣高頻片語：around the world / throughout the world (全球各地)。

example.en: Management commended employees for their outstanding contribution to corporate innovation.
example.zh: 管理階層對全體同仁在企業創新研發方面所做出的卓越貢獻深表嘉許。

reviewWords.mnemonic: contribute 的名詞形式；make a contribution to (對...做出貢獻)。

example.en: We sincerely appreciate your ongoing corporate patronage and support of our products.
example.zh: 我們由衷感謝您對本公司產品的持續愛護惠顧與大力支持。

reviewWords.mnemonic: ad- (向) + preti (價格、價值) + -ate ＝ 認可其價值 ＝ 感謝或資產升值。

example.en: The regional chapter of the international chamber of commerce convened its annual summit.
example.zh: 國際商會的該地區分會假本地召開了年度高峰代表大會。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益雙考點：專業組織地方分會 (local chapter) 或重組破產保護 (Chapter 11)。

example.en: All research engineering personnel must sign binding trade secret non-disclosure agreements.
example.zh: 所有研發工程技術人員均必須簽署具備法律約束力的營業秘密保密合約。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 營業機密法規必考搭配：trade secret (營業秘密)、keep secret (保密)。

example.en: Apparently, the shipment delay was caused by severe weather at the transshipment port.
example.zh: 顯然，這次的出貨延誤是由轉運港口遭遇惡劣天候所導致的。

reviewWords.mnemonic: apparent (顯而易見的) + -ly (副詞尾) ＝ 據了解、顯然地。

example.en: The research engineering group patented a novel approach to rechargeable lithium battery manufacturing.
example.zh: 該研發工程團隊為一種新穎創新的可充電鋰電池製造技術申請了專利。

reviewWords.mnemonic: nov- (新) ＝ 創新獨特的 (novel idea / novel approach)。

example.en: Management and labor union leaders negotiated the terms of the new collective wage contract.
example.zh: 管理階層與工會代表共同協商了新一期集體薪資勞動合約的各項條款。

reviewWords.mnemonic: uni- (單一) + -on (名詞) ＝ 團結為一體 ＝ 勞工工會 (labor union)。

example.en: The startup tech firm is closely tracking its monthly cash burn rate to secure runway.
example.zh: 該科技新創公司正密切追蹤其每月的現金消耗率，以確保營運資金維持充足。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 新創財務核心術語：burn rate (資金消耗率)；burnout (職場過勞)。

example.en: Industry market analysts highlighted a growing consumer trend toward eco-friendly packaging.
example.zh: 產業市場分析師指出消費者對環保包裝呈現日益增長的市場趨勢。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商業分析必備：market trend (市場趨勢)、upward trend (上升走勢)。

example.en: The company completed its initial public offering on the international stock exchange.
example.zh: 該公司在國際證券交易所順利完成了首次公開發行上市 (IPO)。

reviewWords.mnemonic: init- (開始) + -ial ＝ 最初的 (initial investment / IPO)；動詞指在合約上簡簽。

example.en: It is our absolute pleasure to introduce our international keynote speaker this morning.
example.zh: 今天上午我們感到無比榮幸能為各位介紹本場國際主題演講貴賓。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務禮儀必備套話：It's a pleasure (很榮幸)；with pleasure (十分樂意)。

example.en: Employees are invited to drop workflow enhancement ideas into the suggestion box.
example.zh: 公司歡迎全體同仁將工作流程改進構想投入意見建議箱。

reviewWords.mnemonic: suggest (提議) + -ion (名詞尾) ；suggestion box (意見箱)。

example.en: Securing additional financing is critical to the timely completion of the infrastructure project.
example.zh: 獲得額外融資對於如期完成該項基礎建設計畫而言至關重要。

reviewWords.mnemonic: crit- (判斷、決定) + -ical ＝ 具決定性重大影響的 ＝ 關鍵重要的。

example.en: Market researchers gather quantitative survey feedback from prospective retail shoppers.
example.zh: 市場研究人員從潛在零售購物者那裡收集量化問卷回饋資料。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 收集資料或集會：gather information (收集資訊)、gather data (收集數據)。

example.en: Our digital software subscribers are mostly small to mid-sized commercial enterprises.
example.zh: 我們數位軟體的訂閱用戶主要多半是中小型商業企業。

reviewWords.mnemonic: most (最多) + -ly (副詞尾) ＝ 主要地、大體上。

example.en: Our manufacturing corporate pledge includes using only recyclable, earth-friendly materials.
example.zh: 我們製造業的企業承諾包括僅使用可回收的環保友善愛地球材質。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 企業環保永續：earth-friendly (環保的)、on earth。

example.en: The luxury fashion apparel retailer opened a pop-up boutique store in the mall atrium.
example.zh: 這間精品時尚服飾零售商在購物中心中庭開設了一間快閃旗艦概念店。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 新零售行銷必考名詞：pop-up store / pop-up shop (快閃店)。

example.en: Reliable high-speed broadband internet is essential for productive remote office work.
example.zh: 穩定可靠的高速寬頻網路對於維持高效遠距辦公而言是不可或缺的。

reviewWords.mnemonic: ess- (存在) + -ent + -ial ＝ 關乎生存存在的 ＝ 不可或缺的 (essential to/for)。

example.en: The candidate expressed a strong desire to assume international marketing responsibilities.
example.zh: 該應徵者表達了想要承擔跨國行銷業務職責的強烈意願。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 意願與期盼：express a desire (表達意願)、desired outcome (預期成果)。

example.en: We are currently reviewing updated vendor quotes for the corporate office renovation.
example.zh: 我們目前正在審核各家廠商針對企業辦公室重新整修所提交的最新報價單。

reviewWords.mnemonic: current (當前的) + -ly (副詞尾) ＝ 現在、現階段 (currently available)。

example.en: The high-tech manufacturing firm employs over two thousand skilled production technicians.
example.zh: 這家高科技製造公司在本地僱用了兩千多名熟練的產線技術人員。

reviewWords.mnemonic: em- (進入) + ploy (折疊、捲入) ＝ 延攬加入工作；名詞 employee (員工)。

example.en: The corporate management training program offers a clear path to executive promotion.
example.zh: 該企業儲備幹部培訓計畫為同仁晉升為高階主管提供了明確的職涯途徑。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 人資職涯發展常用：career path (職涯發展道路/升遷途徑)。

example.en: Cybersecurity compliance will be the main discussion topic at the quarterly board meeting.
example.zh: 網路安全合規標準將是本季度董事會會議上的主要討論主題。

reviewWords.mnemonic: top- (地方、位置) + -ic ＝ 會議中特定聚焦之處 ＝ 會議主題。

example.en: Guests can relax along the private beachfront or participate in guided water sports.
example.zh: 下榻貴賓可在專屬海灘邊悠閒放鬆，亦可參加專人指導的水上運動項目。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 度假勝地廣告常用：beachfront (海灘第一排)、beach resort (海濱度假村)。

example.en: The international trade symposium attracted business delegates from thirty-five countries.
example.zh: 這場國際商貿研討高峰會吸引了來自三十五個國家的企業商務代表參與。

reviewWords.mnemonic: ad- (向) + tract (拉、牽引) ＝ 拉攏過來 ＝ 吸引 (attract customers/investors)。

example.en: Our digital marketing team uses interactive social media contests to engage potential consumers.
example.zh: 我們的數位行銷團隊透過互動式社群媒體競賽來深度吸引並串連潛在消費者。

reviewWords.mnemonic: en- (進入) + gage (保證、約定) ＝ 深度投身參與 (engage in / engage customers)。

example.en: Our cloud computing infrastructure features powerful data analytics software capabilities.
example.zh: 我們的雲端運算基礎架構具備強大卓越的巨量數據分析軟體運算能力。

reviewWords.mnemonic: power (力量、能力) + -ful (充滿) ＝ 功能強大高效能的。

example.en: Fresh flower arrangements were placed on all conference reception desks this morning.
example.zh: 今天上午所有大會接待櫃檯上都擺放了新鮮優雅的鮮花盆栽花藝。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 宴會接待細節：flower arrangement (花藝佈置)、fresh flowers。

example.en: The corporate public relations division enacted an emergency crisis communication protocol.
example.zh: 企業公共關係部門隨即啟動了緊急危機處理公關溝通作業程序。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 危機處理核心：crisis management (危機管理)、financial crisis (金融危機)。
roots: cris- (crit-) 分辨、審查、決定性時刻

example.en: Clients are kindly requested to settle outstanding hotel room invoices upon checkout.
example.zh: 請各位貴賓在退房辦理離店手續時結清尚未支付的客房消費帳款。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益雙考點：settle an invoice / account (結清帳單) 或 settle a dispute (解決紛爭)。

example.en: The beachfront luxury resort offers complimentary scenic boat tours around the bay.
example.zh: 這間海濱奢華度假飯店提供免費的海灣專人導覽觀光遊船服務。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 出差差旅接駁：boat transfer (渡輪接駁)、boat tour (遊船觀光)。

example.en: Small business enterprises received direct financial aid from regional economic authorities.
example.zh: 小型企業獲得了該地區經濟主管機關發放的直接財政紓困補助金。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 急救與資助：financial aid (財務援助)、first aid (急救措施)。

example.en: Special discounted lodging rates are available for corporate travel groups of ten or more.
example.zh: 十人以上的企業差旅團體可享有專案住宿折扣優惠。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務差旅考點：group rate / group discount (團體優惠價)。

example.en: In case of severe weather emergencies, staff will be notified via our automated text alert system.
example.zh: 萬一發生惡劣天候緊急狀況，將透過自動簡訊警報系統通知全體員工。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益必考條件句型：in case of (萬一發生/在...情況下)。

example.en: The woman who gave the opening keynote speech serves as chief technology officer of the firm.
example.zh: 發表開幕主題演講的女士擔任該公司的技術長。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益聽力短對話 Part 3 常見提問對象：What does the woman suggest?

example.en: The scheduled shuttle bus service departs from terminal one around every twenty minutes.
example.zh: 定時接駁巴士大約每二十分鐘自第一航廈發車一次。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 聽力表示大約時間或費用常客：around three o'clock (大約三點)。

example.en: Business travelers are strongly advised to book their flight tickets at least two weeks in advance.
example.zh: 強烈建議商務旅客至少提前兩週預訂機票。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益極高頻動詞！book = reserve (預約訂位)：book a flight, book a room。

example.en: The resort hotel provides spacious connecting suites tailored for guests traveling with family.
example.zh: 該度假飯店提供專為攜眷出遊旅客設計的寬敞連通套房。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 人資福利與飯店套餐考點：family plan (家庭方案)、family leave (家庭照顧假)。

example.en: There seems to be an error in the final calculation of the shipping charges on this invoice.
example.zh: 這份發票上最終運費的計算似乎出現了一處錯誤。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務書信委婉提出問題的用語：There seems to be a problem。

example.en: Please let the front desk clerk know if you require an iron or extra towels in your room.
example.zh: 若您客房內需要熨斗或額外毛巾，請告知櫃檯接待人員。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務郵件高頻客氣句型：Please let me know (請告知我)。

example.en: Ms. Jenkins comes highly recommended by several prestigious engineering executive directors.
example.zh: 詹金斯女士獲得數位知名工程主管的一致高度推薦。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益極高頻副詞搭配：highly recommended (高度推薦)、highly qualified (條件極佳)。

example.en: Building long-term client trust is essential for sustainable corporate wealth advisory services.
example.zh: 建立長期的客戶信賴對於永續經營企業財富顧問服務至關重要。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商業信用基礎：mutual trust (互信)、earn trust (贏得信賴)。

example.en: Guests expressed that they had a truly wonderful dining experience at the resort restaurant.
example.zh: 賓客們表示在度假村餐廳享受到了一次極為美妙出色的用餐體驗。

reviewWords.mnemonic: wonder (驚嘆) + -ful (充滿) ＝ 令人極其滿意讚嘆的。

example.en: Our logistics courier offers a convenient flat rate shipping fee for standard parcel boxes.
example.zh: 我們的快遞物流為標準包裹紙箱提供便捷的單一固定運費。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益商業財經核心搭配：flat rate (單一費率)、sales remained flat (營收持平未增減)。

example.en: Meeting the strict delivery deadline is absolutely critical to retaining this corporate client.
example.zh: 嚴格達成交貨期限對於留住這家企業重要客戶而言是絕對關鍵的。

reviewWords.mnemonic: ab- (離) + solut (鬆開、解開) ＝ 完全不受拘束 ＝ 絕對地 (absolutely necessary)。

example.en: Careful working capital management ensures steady cash flow during seasonal sales slowdowns.
example.zh: 審慎的營運資金管理確保了在淡季銷售放緩期間仍維持穩定的現金流。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益財務極高頻：cash flow (現金流)；workflow (工作流程)。

example.en: Our recruitment team booked an exhibition booth at the metropolitan job fair next month.
example.zh: 我們的招募團隊在下個月的都會就業博覽會上預訂了展覽攤位。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 名詞常考商展：job fair (就業博覽會)、trade fair (貿易展)；形容詞指公平 (fair share)。

example.en: The project supervisor requested additional funding resources to hire temporary contract workers.
example.zh: 專案主管申請了額外的預算資源以聘請臨時約聘人員。

reviewWords.mnemonic: add (增加) + -tion (名詞) + -al ＝ 附加的 (additional charge / info)。

example.en: The supermarket chain procures fresh organic vegetables directly from certified local farms.
example.zh: 該連鎖超市直接自在地獲得認證的有機農場採購新鮮生鮮蔬菜。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 採購食品原物料常用：organic farm (有機農場)、farm-to-table (產地直送餐桌)。

example.en: The fashion retailer will launch its new autumn clothing collection in flagship stores.
example.zh: 該時尚零售商將在旗艦門市發表其全新的秋季服裝系列產品。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益雙考點：new collection (新系列商品) 或 debt collection (催討應收帳款)。

example.en: Hotel guests may hang the 'Do Not Disturb' card outside on their room door handle.
example.zh: 飯店房客可將「請勿打擾」標示卡懸掛在房門把手外側。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 客房常考：hang a sign (掛上標示牌)；片語 hang up (掛斷電話)。

example.en: Customer service representatives responded quickly to resolve negative online reviews.
example.zh: 客服專員迅速做出回應以處理並解決網路上的負面評價。

reviewWords.mnemonic: neg- (否定、拒絕) + -ive ＝ 負面的 (negative feedback / review)。

example.en: The marketing department divided our consumer products into distinct premium pricing bands.
example.zh: 行銷部門將我們的消費性產品劃分入不同的優質價格區間帶。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 名詞指樂團或「價格區間帶 (price band) / 頻寬 (broadband)」。

example.en: We evaluated the relative cost advantages of local manufacturing versus offshore outsourcing.
example.zh: 我們評估了在地製造與海外委外代工兩者之間的相對成本優勢。

reviewWords.mnemonic: re- (回) + lat (帶來) + -ive ＝ 相互帶入比較的 ＝ 相對的。

example.en: Prospective overseas investors were taken on a comprehensive guided tour of the factory plant.
example.zh: 海外潛在投資人獲邀參加了一場全方位的工廠廠區專人導覽參訪。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 參訪行程常見：guided tour (專人導覽)、factory tour (廠房巡視參觀)。

example.en: Management explored alternative shipping suppliers to mitigate ongoing maritime freight delays.
example.zh: 管理階層評估了替代的航運供應商以緩解持續發生的海運延誤危機。

reviewWords.mnemonic: alter (其他、改變) + -ative ＝ 其他可選的路徑 ＝ 替代方案。

example.en: The corporate technology team deployed enterprise accounting software across all branches.
example.zh: 企業資訊科技團隊在所有分行全面佈署了企業資源會計軟體。

reviewWords.mnemonic: soft (軟) + ware (器具製品) ＝ 電腦軟體（注意不可數名詞）。

example.en: Every technician working on the electronic assembly line is issued a pair of anti-static gloves.
example.zh: 每位在電子組裝產線工作的技術員皆獲發一雙防靜電手套。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 量詞常用：a pair of (一雙/一副)；pair up with (與...搭配合作)。

example.en: The automated distribution center can ship confirmed online retail orders within twenty-four hours.
example.zh: 該自動化物流中心能在二十四小時內將確認的線上零售訂單完成出貨。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 物流核心動詞：ship an order (訂單出貨)；名詞 shipment (裝運貨物)。

example.en: A positive customer-first attitude is the most valued quality in our hospitality staff.
example.zh: 積極主動的顧客至上心態是我們飯店款待人員中最受看重的特質。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 職場考核重點：positive attitude (正向態度)、attitude towards work。

example.en: Budget airlines offer cheap domestic fares by charging extra for checked baggage.
example.zh: 廉價航空公司透過對托運行李額外收費來提供極為便宜的國內線機票。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 價格實惠 (cheap airfare)；在商務文案中常以 affordable 代替以避免廉價感。

example.en: Our digital sales revenue doubled following the nationwide promotional discount campaign.
example.zh: 在全國性促銷折扣活動推行之後，我們的數位銷售營收翻倍成長。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 業績翻倍 (revenue doubled)；飯店 double room (雙人客房)。

example.en: The final flight leg of our business journey departs from Frankfurt at eight tonight.
example.zh: 我們出差行程的最後一段航程預定於今晚八點自法蘭克福起飛。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益旅行航段特殊義：the first/last leg of the journey (旅程的第一/最後一段)。

example.en: All factory production contractors must strictly observe national environmental safety regulations.
example.zh: 所有工廠生產承包商均必須嚴格遵守國家環境保護安全法規。

reviewWords.mnemonic: ob- (朝向) + serv (守護、注意) ＝ 留心注意 ＝ 觀察或嚴格遵守規章。

example.en: Please draft a concise summary sentence to introduce the main points of the proposal.
example.zh: 請撰寫一句簡明扼要的摘要句，以引言說明企劃案的核心要點。

reviewWords.mnemonic: sent- (感覺、判斷) ＝ 表達完整判斷意義的話 ＝ 句子或司法判決。

example.en: Please print fifty copies of the executive conference agenda for our board members.
example.zh: 請為董事會成員列印五十份主管會議議程。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 辦公室硬體：laser printer (雷射印表機)、fine print (合約細則小字)。

example.en: The project development team will present a quarterly progress report to senior stakeholders.
example.zh: 專案開發團隊將向資深專案利害關係人提交季度進度報告。

reviewWords.mnemonic: pro- (向前) + gress (行走) ＝ 向前邁進 ＝ 進度、進展 (progress report)。

example.en: Transparent accounting audits reveal the underlying financial truth of company operations.
example.zh: 透明公開的會計審計能如實揭露公司日常營運背後的真實財務現況。

reviewWords.mnemonic: true (真實的) + -th (抽象名詞尾) ＝ 真理、事實真相。

example.en: Nobody was permitted inside the server room without displaying a verified authorization badge.
example.zh: 未出示經核實的授權識別證者，任何人皆不得進入伺服器主機室。

reviewWords.mnemonic: no + body (人) ＝ 沒有任何人。

example.en: Quality control inspectors will thoroughly examine every electronic circuit component for manufacturing defects.
example.zh: 品管檢驗人員將澈底檢查每個電子電路元件是否存在製造缺陷。

reviewWords.mnemonic: ex- (出) + ag- (秤量、衡量) ＝ 嚴格檢測 ＝ 檢查、檢視。

example.en: Due to company restructuring, the corporate management had to lay off sixty workers.
example.zh: 由於公司組織重整，企業管理層不得不裁減解僱六十名員工。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益人資必考片語：lay off (裁員解僱)；lay off workers (裁撤勞工)。

example.en: Upgrading automated processing equipment will greatly improve order fulfillment turnaround speed.
example.zh: 升級自動化處理設備將大幅提升訂單履行完成的周轉處理速度。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務效率核心詞：high speed (高速)、speed up (加速)。

example.en: The courier scheduled the package delivery between two and four in the afternoon.
example.zh: 快遞人員已將包裹配送時段排定在下午兩點到四點之間。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 時間與地點範圍經典介系詞：between A and B (在A與B之間)。

example.en: Please feel free to ask our customer service representative if you need any assistance.
example.zh: 如果您需要任何協助，請隨時向我們的客服專員詢問。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務書信與服務極高頻客氣片語：feel free to (請隨時/別客氣)。

example.en: The original quote was deemed too high, so the purchasing agent negotiated for a discount.
example.zh: 最初的報價被認為過高，因此採購專員進行了議價以爭取折扣。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務談判表示超出預算常用 too high / too expensive；放句尾表「也」。

example.en: The accounting division is still waiting for the client to confirm invoice details.
example.zh: 會計部門仍在等待客戶確認發票詳細資訊。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 表示進度尚在處理中：still pending (仍在審核中/尚未定案)。

example.en: Our support technicians are trained to identify and solve technical problems quickly.
example.zh: 我們的支援技術人員受過專業訓練，能夠迅速發現並解決技術問題。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 客服與維修的核心搭配：solve a problem (解決問題)、technical problem (技術故障)。

example.en: The senior research associate was asked to write a comprehensive report on market trends.
example.zh: 資深研究專員受命撰寫一份關於市場趨勢的綜合報告。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 職場公文必備動作：write a report (寫報告)、write a proposal (寫提案)。

example.en: All orders placed prior to eleven in the morning are processed on the same day.
example.zh: 所有在上午十一點前下達的訂單都會在同一天處理完畢。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 電商與出貨關鍵詞：the same day (同一天)；the same as (與...相同)。

example.en: Visitors are requested to park their cars in the designated parking lot adjacent to the hall.
example.zh: 訪客請將車輛停放在大廳旁的專用停車場內。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益職場場景考點：parking lot (停車場)；a lot of (許多)。
